title: Introspection via Kaomoji
excerpt: The same Russell circumplex falls out of five open-weight LLMs from five different labs; a Bayesian face-likelihood predictor built on three of them hits ~76% accuracy at mapping a kaomoji to its affect quadrant, and 72% on a Claude validation set. Almost ready to ship as a Claude Code extension.
